observations: The Calendar guide is readable before navigation with native reader controls.
Selecting Items replaces it with Museum reading details and the original booked Schedule and owned bookmark.
Selecting Lists replaces the reader with its actual empty catalog.
Selecting Calendar from an Item reader restores its original Schedule details without a webpage.
The ordinary Return regression retains its readable guide and native controls.
limits: Five originals inspected from both complete passing phone functions. Actual Mac UI, physical devices, gestures and whole-app layout/accessibility acceptance remain separate.
